subject: AcmeHealth Private VPC - Post-call recap & next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: AcmeHealth Private VPC - Post-call recap & next steps

Hi Alex / Priya

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and clear next steps. Please reply with any corrections.

Key goals you shared:
- Move sensitive PHI inference workloads off public API and into a Private VPC deployment (on AWS in us-west-2).
- Meet regulatory constraints around data residency and audit logs; prefer customer-managed KMS.
- Keep latency under 120ms p95 for chat interactions; expect ~1k concurrent users during peak daytime.

Primary pain points:
- Current vendor can't meet your network egress policy for air-gapped subnets.
- Need stronger proof of separation for dev/test vs prod and stricter key management controls.
- Procurement requires a clear mutual action plan and 3rd-party security artifacts (SOC2, penetration test summary).

Technical constraints discussed:
- VPC peering restricted  you prefer PrivateLink endpoints or Transit Gateway with strict route tables.
- No outbound internet access from inference hosts; outbound updates must be staged via an internal repository or bundle (air-gap-friendly).
- Accepted cert/key management: AWS KMS (customer-managed CMK) or HSM via our integrations.

Attachments included:
- acmehealth_network_requirements.pdf (your network notes from today)
- redwood_private_deploy_checklist.xlsx (initial checklist & responsibilities)

Proposed next steps:
1) Dev/Networking sync: Marissa (solutions engineer) + your NetworkOps team to review VPC architecture and PrivateLink patterns  target this week.
2) Security artifact handoff: we'll upload SOC2 and penetration summary to the shared Drive link and provide a short technical Q&A.
3) Cost/Throughput estimate: we'll provide a Dedicated/Private sizing + cost range based on the concurrent user profile.
4) Procurement: draft mutual action plan and procurement checklist (we can include a pre-populated SOW template).

Can we lock the Network sync for Friday 08/07 10:00-11:00 PT? If that doesn't work, suggest two alternatives.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0147
https://redwood.ai

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, NetworkOps <netops@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AcmeHealth Private VPC - Post-call recap & next steps

Thanks Camila  good notes and appreciate the checklist. A few clarifications from our side:

- Transit Gateway is our preferred topology if Redwood can support TGW attachment with strict route policies. PrivateLink is acceptable for control-plane traffic but we need inference data flow within TGW.
- Air-gap: we cannot allow outbound internet from the inference subnet. Any package updates must be delivered via our internal S3 mirror or via a staging AMI. Can you confirm Redwood supports air-gap-friendly update processes?
- Audit logs: we need access to per-request audit logs (tokenized) stored in our S3 for 7 years. Is that supported?

NetworkOps (cc'd) will drop a short network diagram and firewall requirements.

Friday 10:00 PT works for a 45-minute technical sync  Marissa / Dev, please send an invite.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of AI Engineering | AcmeHealth
alex.johnson@acmehealth.com | +1 206-555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AcmeHealth Private VPC - Post-call recap & next steps

Alex  good questions. Quick technical answers so the Network sync can focus on the specifics:

- TGW vs PrivateLink: Redwood's Private deployment supports TGW attachments. We can place inference hosts in your customer VPC and control traffic via TGW route tables. For control-plane operations (updates, management), we can use a dedicated management VPC with PrivateLink endpoints into your VPC so you retain isolation.
- Air-gap / updates: we support air-gap deployments. Our on-prem/package flow allows you to consume signed bundles (AMI/container images) from an internal S3 mirror. We can schedule a runbook handoff to your ops team for patching cadence.
- Audit logs: we can stream per-request telemetry (redacted/tokenized as required) to your S3 bucket via an encrypted Kinesis Firehose with customer-managed KMS. Retention and lifecycle policies can be configured to meet 7-year retention.

Attached: initial network checklist and a sample runbook stub.

Action items for Fri sync:
- Network diagram review (Acme NetworkOps)
- Confirm TGW attachment steps and route table examples
- Identify required ports/endpoints for PrivateLink & control-plane
- Agree on update delivery pattern (S3 mirror vs bundled AMI)

I'll create a calendar invite for Fri 08/07 10:00 PT and include a short agenda.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
